LED Does Not Turn On 💡.problem: The LED light source does not emit light after the system is powered on.
causes: Disconnection between control board and LED
repairs: Check the LED output voltage from the control board (~24V at CN12)
Reconnect the LED cable if loose
Replace the LED module or LED driver board if voltage is abnormal

Fan Failure or Noise 🌬️.problem: The internal fan does not operate or produces abnormal noise.
causes: Obstruction or debris inside fan housing
repairs: Test fan voltage (~12V); replace if not spinning
Clean any obstruction from the fan area

No Light Output from Front Port 🔦.problem: The system is powered, LED is on, but no light is emitted through the fiber port.
causes: Broken LED optics or fiber output path
Defective or misaligned light guide port
repairs: Verify optical alignment between LED and output port
Check and clean the port window
Replace LED or optical assembly if damaged

System Does Not Power On ⚠️.problem: The power switch is pressed, but the unit does not start.
causes: Faulty power board or no DC output
repairs: Replace power supply board if output is not ~24V
System Does Not Power On ⚠️.manual_reference: HB300L Service Manual - Section 4.2 and 4.3, Page 4-2

Touch Panel Not Responding 📱.problem: Touch input does not register or screen remains black.
repairs: Reconnect cable J10 on the control board
Replace the touchscreen or display board
Check display board output voltages and backlight function
